name: nightwing-starfire
notes: The reported failure. The engine returned a Detective Comics issue that Nightwing appears in and Starfire is merely credited in. The right answers are the runs they co-star in. Note that Tales of the Teen Titans is not a different book: DC renamed The New Teen Titans in 1984 mid-run, same Wolfman and Perez team, so The Judas Contract is part of the same definitive run and counts as a correct top answer.
